name: GD Clipper
description: Records while you play and saves your clear as mp4 (cut + full version). No extra app needed.

enabled.name: Enable recording
enabled.description: Record while you are inside a level.

save-full.name: Save full version
save-full.description: Also save everything from entering the level to the clear (all attempts).

buffer-minutes.name: Max minutes kept (full version)
buffer-minutes.description: Older footage of the current level is dropped after this many minutes.

capture-method.name: Capture method
capture-method.description: ingame reads the picture straight from the game (works in fullscreen, recommended). ddagrab / gdigrab grab the desktop instead - try them only if ingame causes lag.
